newsitem.title: USA: Diana disputes Asensio's design allegations.
newsitem.headline: Diana disputes Asensio's design allegations.

text.p: Diana Corp said Tuesday that its Sattel Communications subsidiary disputed statements made by what the company described as a short-seller of its stock.
Sattel said the statements made by Asensio & Co Inc in a news release Tuesday were an attempt "to put pressure on the stock price by an acknowledged short-seller."
Asensio & Co Inc alleged that "Sattel's hardware and software designs are incompatible, and cannot in any practical way be made compatible, with modern telecommunications equipment."
